annotations.title: UK Trade Tariff: Commodity duties & measures

description: One commodity code: description, section/chapter/heading, third-country duty and every import/export measure (preferential rates, VAT, additional duties, controls with document codes). Give country to keep only what applies to that origin. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

country.description: Country of origin, ISO alpha-2 (e.g. CN, US, IN) — filters measures to those that apply
